caption: The image is a drawing of a tall, wooden grandfather clock standing upright against a plain, light background. The clock is composed of three main stacked sections: a base, a central trunk with a long door, and a wider upper section that houses the clock face. The clock case appears to be made of a reddish-brown wood with visible wood grain patterns and some lighter and darker areas for depth and texture. The top section features ornate carved detailing, including an arched pediment with three finials (one in the center and one on each side) and openwork scroll designs. The clock face is round and white, bordered by an arch and set within the uppermost section; it features black Roman numerals, black hour and minute hands, and some smaller decorative designs in the corners and arch above the dial. The trunk section has a single tall door with a keyhole, and the base features simple molding and paneling. The perspective and lighting are consistent, clearly defining the contours and structure of the grandfather clock.
title: Tall Clock
